processed_ranges.notes: Initial validated batch: scope, glossary, Traditional PCI BIOS entry model, BIOS32 discovery.
Validated batch: PCI BIOS capability discovery, indexed device discovery, Special Cycles, and PCI IRQ routing.
Validated batch: Traditional PCI BIOS conventional and extended Configuration Space access, width-specific read/write calls, and function availability.
Validated batch: Traditional PCI BIOS return codes, UEFI PCI services and root-bridge model, firmware/operating-system handoff, and the ACPI entry to enhanced configuration access.
Validated batch: Enhanced Configuration Access address layout, MCFG, _CBA, multiple-host-bridge mappings, and ACPI PCI host-bridge identification.
Validated batch: ACPI host-bridge resources and INTx routing, plus PCI host-bridge _OSC support and control negotiation through returned Control Field bit 3.
Validated batch: _OSC returned control semantics, query and monotonic-call rules, control-bit dependencies, ASL example boundary, and PCI _DSM revision negotiation.
Validated batch: PCI _DSM function catalog, PCI Express slot information, slot-number tokenization and localized vendor labels, and PCI root-bus capabilities structure.
Validated batch: PCI _DSM Function 4 return wrapper, boot-configuration preservation, LTR limits, device naming hints, post-reset responsibility, and per-device readiness durations.
Validated batch: D3cold auxiliary-power negotiation, PERST# assertion delay, and DPC/Hot-Plug Surprise control including Error Disconnect Recovery boundaries.
Validated batch: DPC containment-port location, vendor-specific TPH Steering Tags, and the PCIe SSD status LED discovery/read/set interface.
Validated batch: generic ACPI PCI slot description, OSHP and hot-plug parameters, plus PCI Expansion ROM image headers, PCIR metadata, chaining, and multi-device lists.
Validated batch: POST Expansion ROM discovery and image selection, PC-compatible INIT relocation/resizing and checksum lifecycle, plus PMM temporary and permanent allocation semantics.
Validated batch: PMM limits and flags, run-time ROM relocation and placement, EBDA fallback, shared interrupt chaining, and firmware-managed Expansion ROM configuration utilities.

Validated final batch: configuration-utility console-redirection behavior and header, DMTF SM CLP pre-boot configuration entry point, and the UEFI Expansion ROM boundary; full-wiki link and citation consistency pass completed.
